purpose: Machine-readable architecture evidence package - NOT a final architecture decision. final_architecture_status is explicitly UNRESOLVED per Section 70.

positive_evidence: PPG-DaLiA (capacity-controlled): A_cap->B ~0.605 bpm, C->B ~0.776 bpm, both 5/5 seeds (results/ppg_dalia_capacity_control.json). The original ~20.6%/23% figure is HISTORICAL_CAPACITY_CONFOUNDED (Model A 8,065 params vs Model B 28,865/29,089 params, not capacity-matched) - never cite it as a clean IMU effect.
candidates.replication: EXTERNAL_REPLICATION_SUPPORTIVE (GalaxyPPG, independent device/subject family - full corrected 6-fold CV COMPLETE: participant-level A_cap->B +0.834 bpm (12/18 favor B), C->B +0.904 bpm (13/18 favor B); window-weighted A_cap->B +0.845 bpm, C->B +0.920 bpm; no sign reversal under either aggregation or leave-one-out exclusion of the most extreme subject. Real, moderate, heterogeneous effect - smaller than the earlier bounded single-fold diagnostic (+1.342/+1.629 bpm on 3/3 subjects), which the full cohort shows was not representative.)
candidates.biological_n: 15 (PPG-DaLiA, inherited); GalaxyPPG: 18 real eligible of 24 (6 excluded for a real reference-ECG-quality defect), all 18 tested across the completed full 6-fold CV (one test appearance each)
candidates.burden_known: IMU co-located with PPG in the same wristband - near-zero marginal burden (established)
candidates.contact_module_impact: single wristband module already assumed for PPG; IMU adds no new contact region
candidates.key_uncertainty: GalaxyPPG's full corrected 6-fold CV is complete and directionally supportive, but the effect is real, moderate, and heterogeneous (6/18 subjects favor A_cap over B) rather than uniform - not yet strong enough on its own to resolve FINAL_ARCHITECTURE, which remains a decision for Emir/Project Coordinator, not this remediation.

candidates.key_uncertainty: Cross-dataset (HMC) replication status - being handled on Claude's line, not resolved here
